description: Get the project's glossary (project terms plus its workspace's): each term with its required translation per language, whether it is case-sensitive, and whether it is prohibited. A translation equal to the term means "do not translate"; a prohibited term must never appear in a translation. Read it before writing or translating copy so terminology stays consistent – the QA glossary check enforces it. Takes no arguments.
name: get_glossary
title: Get Glossary
